question: Difference between WF-C878R and WF-C879R dual-scan speeds
reply:
Got it — you want to know about the dual-scan speeds of the Epson WorkForce Pro WF-C878R and WF-C879R. 

The WF-C878R has a standard automatic reversing ADF scanner that can scan up to 25 pages per minute (ipm). The WF-C879R, on the other hand, features a high-speed single-pass dual-head scanner capable of scanning both sides simultaneously at up to 100 ipm.

If your office handles lots of double-sided documents and needs fast throughput, the WF-C879R is four times faster for duplex scanning.
